pairs: and my Father is the vinedresser.
Omnem palmitem in me non ferentem fructum,
Every branch in me that does not bear fruit,
And each one that does bear fruit,
so that it may bring forth more fruit.
Jam vos mundi estis propter sermonem quem locutus sum vobis.
You are clean now, because of the word that I have spoken to you.
Sicut palmes non potest ferre fructum a semetipso,
Just as the branch is not able to bear fruit of itself,
unless it abides in the vine,
quia sine me nihil potestis facere.
For without me, you are able to do nothing.
Si quis in me non manserit,
If anyone does not abide in me,
and they will gather him and cast him into the fire,
et verba mea in vobis manserint,
and my words abide in you,
then you may ask for whatever you will,
and it shall be done for you.
In hoc clarificatus est Pater meus,
that you should bring forth very much fruit and become my disciples.
As the Father has loved me,
you shall abide in my love,
sicut et ego Patris mei præcepta servavi,
just as I also have kept my Father’s precepts
and I abide in his love.
These things I have spoken to you,
ut gaudium meum in vobis sit,
so that my joy may be in you,
and your joy may be fulfilled.
just as I have loved you.
No one has a greater love than this:
ut animam suam ponat quis pro amicis suis.
that he lay down his life for his friends.
si feceritis quæ ego præcipio vobis.
if you do what I instruct you.
I will no longer call you servants,
quia servus nescit quid faciat dominus ejus.
for the servant does not know what his Lord is doing.
But I have called you friends,
quia omnia quæcumque audivi a Patre meo,
because everything whatsoever that I have heard from my Father,
I have made known to you.
so that you may go forth and bear fruit,
and so that your fruit may last.
ut quodcumque petieritis Patrem in nomine meo,
Then whatever you have asked of the Father in my name,
scitote quia me priorem vobis odio habuit.
know that it has hated me before you.
If you had been of the world,
the world would love what is its own.
quia vero de mundo non estis,
Yet truly, you are not of the world,
sed ego elegi vos de mundo,
but I have chosen you out of the world;
because of this, the world hates you.
Mementote sermonis mei, quem ego dixi vobis:
Remember my saying that I told you:
non est servus major domino suo.
The servant is not greater than his Lord.
et vos persequentur; si sermonem meum servaverunt,
they will persecute you also. If they have kept my word,
Sed hæc omnia facient vobis propter nomen meum:
But all these things they will do to you because of my name,
quia nesciunt eum qui misit me.
for they do not know him who sent me.
and had not spoken to them,
nunc autem excusationem non habent de peccato suo.
But now they have no excuse for their sin.
Si opera non fecissem in eis quæ nemo alius fecit,
If I had not accomplished among them works that no other person has accomplished,
But now they have both seen me,
Sed ut adimpleatur sermo, qui in lege eorum scriptus est:
But this is so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law:
But when the Advocate has arrived,
quem ego mittam vobis a Patre,
whom I will send to you from the Father,
Spiritum veritatis, qui a Patre procedit,
the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father,
he will offer testimony about me.
